description: This file contains a collection of shell script functions used for testing a library called test-lib.sh, including functions to write, run, and verify sub-tests, as well as handle expected outputs and errors.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a test script directory with a shell script that sources 'test-lib.sh' and includes additional script content.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Executes a sub-test by changing directory, setting environment variables, and running the test script, then verifies the return code.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Writes a sub-test and executes it, expecting success.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Writes a sub-test and executes it, expecting an error.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Runs a sub-test assuming successful execution.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Runs a sub-test expecting an error.

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Compares the actual output of a test with the expected output file.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Verifies that the test output matches expected and that error output is empty.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Verifies that the test output and error output match expected.
